uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

512-4091-7066.easyPrerequisites: Avatar Kyoshi and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
512-4091-7066.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Avatar Kyoshi, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-4091-7066.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Avatar Kyoshi's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

5641-6830-6996-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5641-6830-6996-7810.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

2178-2292-7690-7797--165.description:
Activate Agent Phil Coulson by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Hero you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token with defender.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Wall.
When the Wall dies, Agent Phil Coulson triggers, untapping Agent Phil Coulson.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

215-1355-4460.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
215-1355-4460.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

215-1115-1129.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
215-1115-1129.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Harabaz Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Harabaz Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5231-5542-6153.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5231-5542-6153.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Vicious Battlerager from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Vicious Battlerager enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Vicious Battlerager.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Vicious Battlerager token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Vicious Battlerager token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Vicious Battlerager trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5231-5542-6153.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

240-4460-5470-6798.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat from step 2.

141-698-7101.notablePrerequisites: You've gained 2 or more life this turn.
141-698-7101.description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost reduced by Will, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Will.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Will.
Repeat from step 3.

4231-4508-5880-7223.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure, Food and Clue token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-4067-6281-7206.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more creatures.
1805-4067-6281-7206.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Dundoolin Weaver.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Dundoolin Weaver that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Dundoolin Weaver token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dundoolin Weaver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat.

773-1409-5921.description:
Activate Galazeth Prismari by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Galazeth Prismari enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Galazeth Prismari.
Resolve both Galazeth Prismari triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3967-4446-5170-6132.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
3967-4446-5170-6132.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1479-2783-2841-6158.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
1479-2783-2841-6158.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, Nesting Dragon and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3705-5231-5997-7055.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1115-1170-1329-2478.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1003-2173-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

339-413-677-6791.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

565-1858-2020--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1858-2020--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

2760-4279-6578.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
There is at least one other creature on the battlefield.
2760-4279-6578.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any other creature and causing you to draw a card.
If the creature who had the counter placed has 0 toughness, it dies as a state-based action.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat until your opponents do not control any more creatures, or until you draw your library.
If you have cards remaining in your library, you may repeat this combo any time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
2760-4279-6578.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

856-997-4321-6462.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-997-4321-6462.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Kheru Goldkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

4050-5687-6115.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ozox, adding {1}.
When Ozox dies, it and Skittering Precursor trigger.
Resolve the Ozox trigger, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Jumblebones and the other creature token, adding {1}{B}.
When Jumblebones dies, it triggers, returning Ozox from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

413-3055-3175.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

275-1216-1799-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sengir Autocrat, adding {1}.
When Sengir Autocrat leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, exiling all Serf tokens.
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Sengir Autocrat on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Sengir Autocrat into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sengir Autocrat enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating three 0/1 Serf creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the Serfs, adding {3}.
Repeat.

654-774-907.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-3234-4377-5131.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three Islands.
You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
2034-3234-4377-5131.description:
Activate three Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Walk the Aeons with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing World Shaper, adding {C}{C}.
World Shaper dies, triggering its second ability, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Cast World Shaper from your graveyard by paying {3}{G}.
World Shaper enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, allowing you to mill three cards.
Repeat each turn.

527-3750.notablePrerequisites:
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power seven or greater.
527-3750.description:
Activate Selvala to add {3}{R}{R}{G}.
Activate Aggravated Assualt, untapping all creatures you control and gaining an addition combat step and post combat mainphase.
Repeat.

803-1486-1604.notablePrerequisites:
Ith does not have summoning sickness.
"Dwarf" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1486-1604.description:
Attack with Ith.
While Ith is still attacking, activate Ith by tapping itself, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve Ith's ability, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

1306-2882-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
1306-2882-4675-4694.description:
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Mana Crypt enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Mana Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2585-2713.description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Grim Monolith's second ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.
